title: If you like Arc Raiders...
author: ESCLYME
selftext:
I just hit release on Stackers on Itch – a 100% free extraction FPS you can play in a browser tab – no install, no account, no launcher. You drop into automated industrial yards run entirely by machines, pry open caches, and try to extract with everything you're carrying.

Specific to dev process: I worked across Godot, ClaudeCode, Blender, Hermes, and fly. Highly recommend custom skills (I made a brief-to-blender-to-godot), built on top of well known ones (like planning-with-files). Blender MCP is life changing.

Would love any game feedback (on Itch plz).
